ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base pixels with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) linear scar features providing macro-level contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-grey base region punctuated by dispersed, high-contrast linear white filaments oriented at varying angles across both left and right fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 50-degree interior angle; vertical depth approximately 1/8th of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregularities; the boundary is highly jagged with numerous secondary notches and prominent peaks along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep from the median notch to the distal tips, characterized by high local variance due to significant marginal tissue irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, approximately circular, high-contrast white clusters (consistent with barnacle attachment scars) are visible at the distal tips and proximal to the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, multi-directional, unaligned white linear tracks (rake marks) densely covering >50% of the visible ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe marginal jaggedness and loss of tissue integrity along the trailing edge boundary; systemic and dense criss-cross linear rake mark scarring across both lobes.
